crossRefs.note: The Rock: his work is perfect, for all his ways are just. A God of faithfulness who does no wrong, just and right is he.
Now I, Nebuchadnezzar, praise and extol and honor the King of heaven; for all his works are truth, and his ways…
Therefore you shall be perfect, just as your Father in heaven is perfect.
They sang the song of Moses, the servant of God, and the song of the Lamb, saying, “Great and marvelous are your works…
Yahweh’s words are flawless words, as silver refined in a clay furnace, purified seven times.
As for God, his way is perfect. Yahweh’s word is tried. He is a shield to all those who take refuge in him.
Your promises have been thoroughly tested, and your servant loves them.
“Every word of God is flawless. He is a shield to those who take refuge in him.
God is my rock in whom I take refuge; my shield, and the horn of my salvation, my high tower, and my refuge. My savior…
Take hold of shield and buckler, and stand up for my help.
He will cover you with his feathers. Under his wings you will take refuge. His faithfulness is your shield and rampart.
I will tell of the decree: Yahweh said to me, “You are my son. Today I have become your father.

translations.web: As for God, his way is perfect. Yahweh’s word is tested. He is a shield to all those who take refuge in him.
translations.bsb: As for God, His way is perfect; the word of the LORD is flawless. He is a shield to all who take refuge in Him.
translations.kjv: As for God, his way is perfect; the word of the LORD is tried: he is a buckler to all them that trust in him.
translations.asv: As for God, his way is perfect: The word of Jehovah is tried; He is a shield unto all them that take refuge in him.
